title: Can I Use Night Cream in the Day?
ex: Yes, often you can, in a thin layer under sunscreen. Here is when it works, when to skip it, and how to do it by season in India.
rt: Can I Use Night Cream in the Day? | Mirc Glow
rd: Can I use night cream in the day? Often yes, in a thin layer under sunscreen. Learn when it works, when to skip it and how to adjust for Indian weather.
keyword: can I use night cream in the day
quick: Yes, in many cases. Use about half your night-time amount, let it settle for a few minutes, then always apply a broad-spectrum sunscreen of SPF 30 or more. It suits dry or normal skin and winter best; oily skin in hot, humid weather usually does better with a lighter day cream.
facts: Use half the night-time amount in the morning
Always apply SPF 30+ sunscreen on top
Extra care with kojic acid creams in daylight
Night-shift workers should use night cream before they sleep
